jobs.description:
Lead DevOps Engineer  
 As a Lead DevOps Engineer at  Particle41 , you will own the DevOps strategy and the design, automation, and operation of the cloud infrastructure that powers our clients’ most complex digital projects. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will champion DevOps culture and practices, set the standards other teams build on, and ensure the delivery of innovative and high-quality projects. Your role will also involve mentoring and coaching team members, fostering a culture of collaboration, automation, and continuous learning. 
  In This Role, You Will:  
  Strategy & Practice Ownership  
 
 Own the DevOps technical roadmap and vision, in collaboration with architects and stakeholders, and align it with business goals. 
 Define the "golden path": reference architectures, reusable IaC modules, pipeline templates, and standards that teams across projects adopt. 
 Be accountable for platform reliability, security posture, and delivery velocity outcomes across the engagements you lead; measured through SLOs, not just activities performed. 
 Represent the DevOps practice with clients: participate in discovery and pre-sales conversations, estimate and scope infrastructure workstreams, and advise client leadership on cloud and platform decisions. 
 Contribute to growing the practice interview and assess DevOps candidates, and help shape team structure and capability development. 
 
  Infrastructure & Platform Engineering  
 
 Lead the design and implementation of cloud infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and GCP using infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi. 
 Architect and operate container platforms, including Kubernetes (EKS, AKS, GKE) and managed container services, to support scalable, resilient workloads. 
 Define landing zones, account/subscription structures, and network topologies that balance security, cost, and developer velocity. 
 Evaluate and recommend platform tooling and managed services to support business requirements. 
 
  CI/CD & Automation  
 
 Own the CI/CD strategy and pipeline architecture (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, Jenkins) that makes releases fast, repeatable, and safe across teams. 
 Drive an automation-first culture across build, test, deployment, and environment provisioning — setting the standard for eliminating manual toil, and staying hands-on where it matters most. 
 Establish GitOps workflows (e.g., ArgoCD, Flux) for declarative, auditable deployments. 
 
  Reliability & Observability  
 
 Define the observability strategy - monitoring, logging, and tracing (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry) and drive its adoption across teams. 
 Own SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets in partnership with engineering and product teams, and hold teams accountable to them. 
 Own incident response, on-call practices, and blameless post-incident reviews to continuously improve system resilience. 
 Plan for capacity, scalability, and disaster recovery, including backup strategies and multi-region considerations. 
 
  Security & Cost Optimization  
 
 Own the DevSecOps posture: define and embed security standards into the delivery pipeline — secrets management, vulnerability scanning, image signing, and policy as code. 
 Support compliance initiatives (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA) with automated controls and evidence collection. 
 Own cloud cost outcomes: drive right-sizing, autoscaling, and FinOps practices, and report spend posture to stakeholders. 
 
  Mentorship and Coaching  
 
 Mentor and coach DevOps and software engineers to enhance their technical skills and expertise. 
 Foster a culture of collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning. 
 Review infrastructure code and pipeline changes, providing constructive feedback to improve quality and maintainability. 
 
  Leadership  
 
 Provide technical leadership and guidance on infrastructure, platform, and operational decisions.

jobs.description:
Caylent  is an AI-first cloud services company that helps organizations turn ambitious ideas into meaningful business impact. As an AWS Premier Tier Services Partner and a charter member of Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network, we combine deep expertise in AWS, artificial intelligence, and Anthropic’s Claude platform to help customers modernize their technology, build intelligent products, and move AI from experimentation into production. 
 Our capabilities span generative and agentic AI, cloud migration and modernization, cloud-native application development, data and analytics, DevOps, managed services, security and compliance, and customer experience transformation. At Caylent, our people always come first. 
 We are a fully remote global company with employees in Canada, the United States and Latin America. We celebrate the culture of each of our team members and foster a community of technological curiosity. Come talk to us to learn more about what it means to be a Caylien! 
  The Mission  
 This role is a Senior QA/Test Engineer specializing in Amazon Connect and contact center technology, responsible for designing and executing comprehensive test strategies across contact flows, routing, IVR/self-service, and AI-driven conversational agents. They validate legacy-to-Connect migrations, build and maintain manual and automated test suites (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium) spanning UI, API, and serverless backend components, and ensure production readiness through cutover validation, monitoring verification, and incident triage. Beyond hands-on testing, they partner with engineers to shift quality left, run UAT sessions with customer stakeholders, and contribute reusable test assets and mentorship to strengthen Caylent's contact center QA practice. 
   Your Assignment  
   Test Strategy & Contact Center Quality   
 
 Design and execute test strategies for Amazon Connect implementations covering contact flows, routing logic, IVR/self-service, Cases/Tasks workflows, and Contact Lens configurations 
 Build test plans that validate AI agent behavior: intent recognition accuracy, escalation paths, barge-in/fallback handling, hallucination guardrails, and multilingual/SSML voice interactions 
 Validate legacy-to-Connect migrations (i.e. Avaya, Genesys, Connect, NICE) through parallel-run testing, flow conversion verification, and data migration validation 
 Define and track quality metrics (defect density, test coverage, escape rate) and report on release readiness to delivery leads and customer stakeholders 
 Hands-on experience with web application and web automation testing 
 
   Manual, Automated & Full-Stack Testing   
 
 Build, maintain, and execute manual and automated IVR test suites, using tools such as Cyara, Hammer, or Botium (preferred). 
 Build, maintain, and execute manual and automated web application test suites, using frameworks such as Cypress, Selenium, or Playwright (preferred). 
 Build and maintain manual and automated test suites: Playwright E2E and API tests, Cypress, Selenium, integration tests against live Amazon Connect instances, and end-to-end tests of Amazon connect call flows. 
 Test custom Agent Workspace experiences (Amazon Connect, Agent Assist)  
 Validate serverless, event-driven backends (Lambda, EventBridge, Step Functions, SQS/SNS, DynamoDB, Kinesis) with integration and contract tests 
 
   Production Readiness & Operations   
 
 Execute phased rollout and cutover validation for live contact centers, where testing gaps translate directly into missed calls and customer impact 
 Verify monitoring and alerting coverage (CloudWatch metrics, alarms, dashboards) across voice, chat, tasks, queues, agents, Lambda, and AI agents prior to go-live 
 Participate in production incident triage, reproducing defects and validating fixes across the contact center stack 
 Perform security and compliance validation: least-privilege IAM checks, DevSecOps scan review, and encryption standard verification

Your role will also involve mentoring and coaching team members, fostering a culture of collaboration, automation, and continuous learning. 
  In This Role, You Will:  
  Strategy & Practice Ownership  
 
 Own the DevOps technical roadmap and vision, in collaboration with architects and stakeholders, and align it with business goals. 
 Define the "golden path": reference architectures, reusable IaC modules, pipeline templates, and standards that teams across projects adopt. 
 Be accountable for platform reliability, security posture, and delivery velocity outcomes across the engagements you lead; measured through SLOs, not just activities performed. 
 Represent the DevOps practice with clients: participate in discovery and pre-sales conversations, estimate and scope infrastructure workstreams, and advise client leadership on cloud and platform decisions. 
 Contribute to growing the practice interview and assess DevOps candidates, and help shape team structure and capability development. 
 
  Infrastructure & Platform Engineering  
 
 Lead the design and implementation of cloud infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and GCP using infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi. 
 Architect and operate container platforms, including Kubernetes (EKS, AKS, GKE) and managed container services, to support scalable, resilient workloads. 
 Define landing zones, account/subscription structures, and network topologies that balance security, cost, and developer velocity. 
 Evaluate and recommend platform tooling and managed services to support business requirements. 
 
  CI/CD & Automation  
 
 Own the CI/CD strategy and pipeline architecture (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, Jenkins) that makes releases fast, repeatable, and safe across teams. 
 Drive an automation-first culture across build, test, deployment, and environment provisioning — setting the standard for eliminating manual toil, and staying hands-on where it matters most. 
 Establish GitOps workflows (e.g., ArgoCD, Flux) for declarative, auditable deployments. 
 
  Reliability & Observability  
 
 Define the observability strategy - monitoring, logging, and tracing (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry) and drive its adoption across teams. 
 Own SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets in partnership with engineering and product teams, and hold teams accountable to them. 
 Own incident response, on-call practices, and blameless post-incident reviews to continuously improve system resilience. 
 Plan for capacity, scalability, and disaster recovery, including backup strategies and multi-region considerations. 
 
  Security & Cost Optimization  
 
 Own the DevSecOps posture: define and embed security standards into the delivery pipeline — secrets management, vulnerability scanning, image signing, and policy as code. 
 Support compliance initiatives (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA) with automated controls and evidence collection. 
 Own cloud cost outcomes: drive right-sizing, autoscaling, and FinOps practices, and report spend posture to stakeholders. 
 
  Mentorship and Coaching  
 
 Mentor and coach DevOps and software engineers to enhance their technical skills and expertise. 
 Foster a culture of collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning. 
 Review infrastructure code and pipeline changes, providing constructive feedback to improve quality and maintainability. 
 
  Leadership  
 
 Provide technical leadership and guidance on infrastructure, platform, and operational decisions.

 - Contribute to service enhancements, ensuring alignment with business objectives and technical best practices.

 Experience developing Generative AI solutions. Must have built at least one simple AI-powered feature or application end-to-end, and be comfortable with the AI SDLC, not just theoretical exposure.

 Experience deploying and managing services in a cloud-native environment. 
 Experience developing Generative AI solutions 
 Experience with frontend development (React/Vite) for building user interfaces. 
 
  Preferred Qualifications:  
 
 Knowledge of AI/ML model integration and working with AI platforms like AWS Bedrock
